**A fabricated zero the contract had pinned (#882)**

reviewsPosted returned counts.get(actor) ?? 0 with counts keyed by forge login, so a record-namespace actor read 0 reviews — a claim the data cannot back. A PR 5 test had asserted that zero as the contract, so the spec was wrong, not just the code. Superseded with the reason in the test's own text.
